title: Coldsnap Theme Decks: card flavor text

entities.name: General Varchild
entities.description: A general who trusts in her truth over enemy legions.

entities.name: Sorine Relicbane
entities.description: A Soldevi heretic who warns against reviving the Brothers' War and decries the Skull Catapult.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A task mage who quips about destruction, incineration and literature.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
aliases: Gerda Äagesdotter, Archmage of the Unseen
entities.description: Archmage of the Unseen who comments on Lat-Nam and necromancy.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
aliases: Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield who saw her dead friends among Lim-Dûl's legion.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: A Kjeldoran royal mage.

entities.name: Disa the Restless
entities.description: Expedition journal writer who doubts the mistfolk.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Juniper Order advocate.

entities.name: Steinar Icefist
entities.description: A Balduvian shaman.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: Mage who teaches precision and caution.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Walker of Night whose power Lim-Dûl invokes.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who entombs the dead in snow to raise them and serves Leshrac.

entities.name: Toothlicker Harj
entities.description: An orcish captain.

entities.name: Arnjlot Olasson
entities.description: A sky mage.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A Soldevi machinist.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer mentioned as the inventor of the ornithopter.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: Ancient war between Urza and Mishra.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Place whose sages could not be protected from the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent partly flooded by unnatural means.

entities.name: Order of the White Shield
entities.description: Order led by Lucilde Fiksdotter.

entities.name: Mistfolk
entities.description: Cold-lands folk whose existence Disa doubts.

events.summary: General Varchild vows that her truth is stronger than the enemy's swords.
events.quote: I will show them that my truth is stronger than their swords.

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane warns against starting the Brothers' War anew.
events.quote: You would have us start the Brothers' War anew!

events.summary: Gerda says Lat-Nam's sages could not be protected from the Brothers' War.
events.quote: All the knowledge of Lat-Nam could not protect its sages from the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Terisiare's flooding is revealed to be not all natural.
events.quote: Not all of Terisiare's flooding was natural . . . .
Only a necromancer would create such a foul form of divination.

events.summary: Gustha declares that she takes what she wants.
Disa admits doubts about the mistfolk due to eyewitness accounts.
events.quote: my certainty is lessened by the cursed consistency of the expedition's eyewitness accounts.

events.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl's enemies will wither.
events.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl invokes Leshrac to grant him power.
events.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl orders the dead entombed in snow so they will rise to serve.
events.quote: Take their dead, and entomb them in the snow.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl declares his risen Kjeldoran dead will kill those they once loved.
events.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved.

events.summary: Lucilde sees her dead friends in Lim-Dûl's legion and can bear no more.
events.quote: I have seen the faces of my dead friends among that grim band, and I can bear no more.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard jokes about a toasted victim.
events.quote: Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description.

events.summary: Toothlicker Harj laments being talked into a project.
events.quote: How did I ever let myself get talked into this project?

events.summary: Sorine Relicbane denounces the Skull Catapult as sadistic.
events.quote: What manner of fiend would design such a sadistic device?

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson compares his glider to Urza's ornithopter.
events.quote: It's no ornithopter, but then I'm no Urza.

relations.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.
Lucilde Fiksdotter, leader of the Order of the White Shield

relations.note: his legion contains her dead friends
